examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The perks of an upgrade card: four included features, each behind a check mark, in one column.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: Eight perks at `columns: 2`: two columns when the list's own box is at least the md container, one column below it.

examples.name: WithDescriptions
examples.summary: The features of a change-plan drawer, each with a one-line description under its label.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same content written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<PlanFeatureList>` tag into a real `PlanFeatureList`. Braced attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same content in the marketing site's page JSON: `PlanFeatureList` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"` and `texture: "none"`, so nothing is painted behind it) and `SitePage` renders the entry with no code.
